answer: Metformin is being studied for healthspan extension because it activates AMPK [s1]. The TAME trial has been proposed.

citations.title: Barzilai N et al. Metformin as a Tool to Target Aging. Cell Metab 2016
citations.snippet: Metformin activates AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), inhibits mitochondrial complex I, and has been associated with reduced all-cause mortality in observational studies of type 2 diabetics.

answer: Minoxidil was first an antihypertensive and is used topically for hair loss [s1].

citations.title: Goren A et al. SULT1A1 activity and topical minoxidil response.
citations.snippet: Topical minoxidil requires sulfation by SULT1A1 in the scalp to its active form, minoxidil sulfate. Patients with low SULT1A1 activity show diminished response to topical minoxidil.

answer: Thalidomide is effective in multiple myeloma, with anti-angiogenic and immunomodulatory effects [s1]. Lenalidomide is a related drug.

citations.title: Lu G et al. The Myeloma Drug Lenalidomide Promotes the Cereblon-Dependent Destruction of IKZF1 and IKZF3. Science 2014
citations.snippet: Lenalidomide acts through cereblon (CRBN) to selectively destabilize the transcription factors IKZF1 and IKZF3, which are required for myeloma cell survival. Thalidomide and pomalidomide share this mechanism.

answer: Nirmatrelvir (Paxlovid) inhibits the SARS-CoV-2 main protease and reduces hospitalization in high-risk patients [s1].

citations.title: Hammond J et al. Oral Nirmatrelvir for High-Risk, Nonhospitalized Adults with Covid-19 (EPIC-HR). NEJM 2022
citations.snippet: Nirmatrelvir is an orally bioavailable inhibitor of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro/3CLpro), co-administered with ritonavir as a pharmacokinetic enhancer. EPIC-HR showed ~89% reduction in hospitalization or death.
